hints: For Falcons (n = 15), find the median and quartiles from the ordered list.
Median is the (15 + 1) / 2 = 8th value: Median = 51 minutes.
Lower quartile Q1 is the (15 + 1) / 4 = 4th value: Q1 = 44 minutes.
Upper quartile Q3 is the 3*(15 + 1) / 4 = 12th value: Q3 = 59 minutes.
walkthrough:
Identify the positions of the median and quartiles for the $n = 15$ ordered times of the Falcons:
- Position of Median: $\frac{15 + 1}{2} = 8\text{th value} \implies \text{Median} = 51\text{ minutes}$
- Position of $Q_1$: $\frac{15 + 1}{4} = 4\text{th value} \implies Q_1 = 44\text{ minutes}$
- Position of $Q_3$: $\frac{3(15 + 1)}{4} = 12\text{th value} \implies Q_3 = 59\text{ minutes}$

Calculate the interquartile range (IQR):
$$\text{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 59 - 44 = 15\text{ minutes}$$

skill_tags: Calculating a Mean from Raw Data

hints: Combine all 30 times: sum(x) = sum(Falcons) + sum(Kites).
Calculate sum(x^2): sum(Falcons^2) = 41532, sum(Kites^2) = 42218, total sum(x^2) = 83750.
walkthrough:
Calculate the total sum $\sum x$ and sum of squares $\sum x^2$ for all $30$ runners:
$$\sum x_{\text{Falcons}} = 772, \quad \sum x_{\text{Kites}} = 784 \implies \sum x = 772 + 784 = 1556$$
$$\sum x_{\text{Falcons}}^2 = 41532, \quad \sum x_{\text{Kites}}^2 = 42218 \implies \sum x^2 = 41532 + 42218 = 83750$$

Compute the overall mean:
$$\bar{x} = \frac{\sum x}{n} = \frac{1556}{30} = 51.867 \approx 51.9\text{ minutes} \quad (51.86 \le \bar{x} \le 51.9)$$

Compute the standard deviation:
$$\sigma = \sqrt{\frac{\sum x^2}{n} - \bar{x}^2} = \sqrt{\frac{83750}{30} - \left(\frac{1556}{30}\right)^2}$$
$$\sigma = \sqrt{2791.6667 - 2690.1511} = \sqrt{101.5156} \approx 10.075 \approx 10.1\text{ minutes}$$
$$(10.07 \le \sigma \le 10.1)$$

ai_rubric.Calculating Standard Deviation from Raw: Calculates mean = 51.9 minutes and standard deviation = 10.1 minutes from sum(x)=1556 and sum(x^2)=83750.

teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Calculate the summary sums for all n = 30 runners:
- Falcons ($n_1 = 15$):
  * $\sum x_1 = 772$
  * $\sum x_1^2 = 41532$
- Kites ($n_2 = 15$):
  * $\sum x_2 = 784$
  * $\sum x_2^2 = 42218$
Combined totals ($n = 30$):
$$\sum x = 772 + 784 = 1556$$
$$\sum x^2 = 41532 + 42218 = 83750$$

Step 2: Calculate the mean:
$$\bar{x} = \frac{\sum x}{n} = \frac{1556}{30} = 51.866... \approx 51.9\text{ minutes}$$

Step 3: Calculate the standard deviation:
$$\sigma = \sqrt{\frac{\sum x^2}{n} - \bar{x}^2}$$
$$\sigma = \sqrt{\frac{83750}{30} - (51.866...)^2} = \sqrt{2791.6667 - 2690.1511} = \sqrt{101.5156} = 10.075... \approx 10.1\text{ minutes}$$
(To 3 significant figures).
